course.title: Electrical and Electronic Engineering BEng | Imperial College London
quotes: Qualification BEng Duration 3 years Start date October 2027 UCAS course code H600
Delivered by Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

Minimum entry standard A*A*A or A*AAA To include: A* in Mathematics A*/A in Physics ( A* is required if applying with three A-levels. At least an A is required if applying with four A-levels) A in a third and/or fourth subject
Minimum entry standard 40 points To include: 7 in Mathematics at higher level 7 in Physics at higher level

EITHER 5, 5, 5, 5, 5 overall, to include Calculus BC, Physics C (Mechanics) and Physics C (Electricity and Magnetism) and two further relevant subjects OR 5, 5, 5 to include Calculus BC, Physics C (Mechanics) or Physics C (Electricity and Magnetism) Award of acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g., US High School Diploma) Either 1480 in SAT or 33 in ACT.
Our minimum entry standard is 92% overall, to include: 95% in Mathematics 95% in Physics 90% Other
Our minimum entry standard is 1.4 overall, to include the following abiturprufung exams: 14 in Mathematics 14 in Physics
you will need to sit three ESAT modules: Mathematics 1 Mathematics 2 Physics
must achieve the higher university requirement
Application deadlines - Wednesday 13 January 2027 at 18.00 (UK time)
